purpose: 도착과 실제 lane 해제에 따른 자원/대기 정책의 일정·응답·J·AP 독립 확인

energy.family: preload baseline plus four nonnegative whole-state increments
energy.fit: enumerate nonnegative active sets; full column rank required; report singular values; numerical rank not practical precision

ap.family: fixed M0 beta/tau/g; one nonnegative load gain k
ap.initialization: existing preload AP initializer; brackets strictly before common+35
ap.fit: equal-session weighted least squares k>=0, no model family search

service.reason: observed context already includes interference; no double slowdown; no new throttle law

outputs: prospective arrival-to-schedule cost using frozen phase means and pre35 observations
all-planned denominator response P95 and deadline completion
paired observed policy differences with two-repeat ranges, no universal CI or accuracy PASS
stop: incomplete development or rank deficient energy/gain inputs
no new block without full reserved remaining time

interpretation.scope: A24 registered models/resident/protocol/policies/input family only; no universal thermal performance

selection: one family fixed before these new outcomes; old failures and coefficients preserved; two confirmation sessions per policy are not population precision
